description: Legacy alias of the free verified_route preview (kept for back-compat). Vets one Coinbase Bazaar search for a need within a budget: drops stubs, down-ranks factory clones and one-wallet or one-call-per-wallet usage, ranks on distinct payers, and names a pick only above a confidence floor (otherwise verdict no_confident_pick). Returns the pick's name, usage stats and reason; the provider URL and ready-to-pay details are withheld, as in the preview. This is NOT the paid verified_route, which ranks the whole catalog with sybil collapse and delivery evidence. Advise-only — no payment happens here. Prefer verified_route.  Use when: "which x402 tool for X", "find a paid API for X under $Y".

budget.description: Maximum USDC per call (default 0.01). Tools priced above this are excluded.

need.description: What capability you need, e.g. "funding rates", "token security", "DeFi TVL"

name: route
